title: Heroic Sacrifice
caption: Heroic Sacrifice (V)
game_text: Deploy on opponent’s just deployed {maintenance} card; opponent loses 1 Force and you may retrieve 1 Force. That card may not apply its ability toward drawing battle destiny, is power -3, and gains (in addition to its own maintenance cost): “{icon:maintenance-star}Lose 1 Force, or {icon:maintenance-skull}.” {control}
lore: The Alliance lost many fine soldiers at conflicts such as the Battle of Hoth. The Rebel High Command is aware of the cost of freedom from Imperial tyranny.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique. Base card is Special Edition (1998; '1998 DECIPHER INC.' legible on the scan). Inline gold wheel = {maintenance}. Inside the quoted maintenance phrase the slip prints Decipher's typographic maintenance glyphs: a six-pointed star ✶ (directly before 'Lose', no space) → {icon:maintenance-star}, and a skull-and-crossbones ☠ (before the period) → {icon:maintenance-skull}; the wiki stub calls the skull '(grabber)', but the slip glyph is a skull, not the hand grabber icon of the cover ICON KEY. Text ends with the red circle-slash C (immune to Control) and no period after it. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px. No modern/VB remake image exists on the wiki (modern null).
